verses.text: For the married woman is bound by law to the living husband; but if the husband should die, she is released from the law of the husband.

verses.text: So then, the husband being alive, she will be called an adulteress if she may become unto another man; but if the husband should die, she is free from the law, [so as] not for her to be an adulteress, having become unto another man.

verses.text: Likewise, my brothers, you⁺ also have been put to death to the law through the body of Christ, for you⁺ to become unto another, unto the [One] having been raised out from [the] dead, so that we should bear fruit to God.

verses.text: What then will we say? [Is] the law sin? Never may it be! But I did not know sin, if not through [the] law. For I would not have been conscious of covetousness if the law had not said, “You shall not covet.”
